title: Design: Finance tab menu of a closed internal work order holds Reopen Work Order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Have a closed internal work order, made for this test.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow2-12-05-finance-tab-closed.png, iwo-happy-29-29-closed-no-charge-document.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the closed internal work order.
  2. Click the Finance tab.
  3. Open the invoice menu on the document.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The INTERNAL document shows.

Step 3:

  • The menu holds "Reopen Work Order" where a billable work order shows Reverse, and no Issue Credit.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11761 (Story 4, Reopen a closed internal or no-charge work order)

  • S4-R1: “On a closed internal or no-charge work order the Finance tab's invoice menu shows "Reopen Work Order" where a billable work order shows "Reverse", and no Issue Credit. It is the only place to reopen; the work order header carries the line of S2-R9 and no button.”
  • S3-R6: “The Finance tab menu of the closed work order offers Reopen Work Order only (S4-R1); Issue Credit is not shown, as there is nothing to credit.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
